question: Shared append-only log (blackboard/inbox) vs direct point-to-point messaging for async multi-agent coordination — which should Construct default to?
summary: Derived that a shared log wins when the consumer set is unbounded/growing, consumers run async, and a durable audit trail has independent value; direct messaging wins for tight sync request/response. Concluded production systems layer both, matching the PRAXIS inbox + direct Agent/SendMessage split already in use. Corpus (blackboard architecture literature, pub/sub docs, a 2026 piece on blackboard patterns returning for LLM multi-agent systems) confirmed this near-verbatim, plus supplied quantified O(N^2) topology cost and a 13-57% empirical success-rate delta not derivable from principles alone.
